findings.result: Nine foundation lessons are supported in both texts; formal IPM organization and economic-loss objective are explicitly2go-only.1go also mentions component techniques, so no claim that those techniques exist only in2go is made.

No agronomic application rates, hormone concentrations, leaf-fruit ratios, cooling temperature/time or generalized working dates are prescribed. Eight-shaped tie is source-grounded geometric instruction, not a numerical rate.

Agricultural-chemical category names are kept separate from product selection, concentration, frequency and legal authorization. Film-disposal law/current product requirements are held rather than generalized. Biodegradability is not presented as blanket permission to leave films anywhere.

Defines stigma attachment correctly; common crop/insect examples are bounded. Does not guarantee set after pollination, avoiding conflict with2go fertilization/self-incompatibility/parthenocarpy details held for later authoring.
Transparent/green/white/black/silver summaries match both source tables. Does not assert all colors equally suppress weeds or all covering excludes all pests.
Cooling for freshness is supported. The packet deliberately does not teach source1vacuum explanatory wording as an exact physical process or generalize2gocoolingmethod suitability.
